question: Who among the following won Arjuna Award 2021 in Para Table Tennis discipline?
solution:
the correct answer is __**Bhavina Patel**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhavina** **Patel** is an **Indian parathlete and table tennis player from Mehsana, Gujarat**
 
• She won a **silver medal** in Class 4 Table tennis at the **2020 Summer Paralympics** **in Tokyo**.
 
• In the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics **, she reached the semi-finals after defeating **Borislava Rankovic** and won the silver medal after being defeated by** ****Zhou Ying**.
 
• she has been conferred with the Arjuna award **in recognition of her achievements in the field of sports (Table Tennis), from the President of India**.**​**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Sharath **won the men's singles gold in the 16th **Commonwealth table tennis championship** held in Kuala Lumpur in **2004**. 
 
• He is a recipient of the **Arjuna award for the year 2004.**
 
• **Manika Batra** is an **Indian Table Tennis**** player**. As of November 2020, she is the top-ranked female table tennis player in India and ranked 50th in the world as of March 2022. She was awarded the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna **award in 2020.
 
• 
 
 
Salim Durani was the first player to win the Arjuna Award for Cricket. Instituted in 1961, the Arjuna Award comprises a bronze statuette of Arjuna, certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize of ₹15 lakh.
